title: CytoLex KB — vocabulary file
description: A list printed in the book (ch. 3 symbols, Table 2 banding codes) as a machine-usable vocabulary: kb/vocab/<version>/<section-file>.yaml. kb build checks that the entry labels equal the first column of the cited source table. Conventions: kb/README.md.

vocabulary.description: Name of the vocabulary; unique per edition.

source.description: Every chunk block holding the printed list (¶ per page, or a table float). Their first-column cells must equal the set of entry labels.

shared_tokens.description: Tokens that may belong to more than one entry (e.g. '.' = decimal point and period). Any other token used twice is an error.

review.description: Review state of the whole file: paraphrase_checked = a person approved the meanings against the book.

label.description: First-column text exactly as in the chunk table (e.g. 'plus sign, single (+)'). Used for the coverage check; never part of a notation string.

tokens.description: What appears in a notation string, as the book prints it (e.g. ['+'], ['I', 'II', 'III', 'IV'], ['→', '->']). Empty only for kind typographic.

pair.description: Opening and closing token of a bracket pair; both must be in tokens.

kind.description: abbreviation (letters: del, GRCh), punctuation (signs: +, ::, ( )), typographic (formatting with no typed token: underlining), code (banding technique codes).

meanings.description: One item per meaning in the book's description (split at ';'). text is a paraphrase; sections are the book's cross-references.

note.description: Remarks for parser authors (e.g. the token is not typeable).
